description: In two renamed copies of an expanded language, let \(R\) and \(S\) be the distinct new relations, and let \(A\) and \(B\) be their finite axiom conjunctions. Any formula using only symbols common to \(A\land R(\bar x)\) and \(B\to S(\bar x)\) uses only old-language symbols.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.interpolant_oldOnly.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ}
  (Γ Δ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.extended L n).Sentence)
  (θ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.doubled L n).Formula (Fin n))
  (h :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols θ ⊆
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.finiteConj false Γ ⊓
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.sideAtom false) ∩
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols
          ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.finiteConj true Δ).imp
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.sideAtom true))) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.OldOnly
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols θ)
